in_sanskrit.name: Ranchhod
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord Rama
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ranchhod एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who has the control of the senses, is the master of the mind and the body and is devoted to Lord Rama.

in_tamil.name: Ranchhod
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Lord Rama
in_tamil.long_meaning: Ranchhod ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One who has the control of the senses, is the master of the mind and the body and is devoted to Lord Rama.

in_telugu.name: Ranchhod
in_telugu.long_meaning: Ranchhod ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who has the control of the senses, is the master of the mind and the body and is devoted to Lord Rama.

in_marathi.name: Ranchhod
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ranchhod हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who has the control of the senses, is the master of the mind and the body and is devoted to Lord Rama.

in_bengali.name: Ranchhod
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord Rama
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ranchhod একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who has the control of the senses, is the master of the mind and the body and is devoted to Lord Rama.
